subject: Computação
description_pt: Explorar e construir a solução de problemas por meio de refinamentos, utilizando diversos níveis de abstração desde a especificação até a implementação.

components.description_pt: Identificar os requisitos do problema necessários para especificar uma solução computacional
components.description_en: Identify the problem requirements needed to specify a computational solution
components.cc_component_description: Define a design problem by specifying the object, tool, process, or system needed to solve it

components.description_pt: Decompor problema complexo do mundo real em sub-problemas menores e independentemente solúveis
components.description_en: Decompose a complex real-world problem into smaller, independently solvable sub-problems
components.cc_component_description: Decompose a complex real-world problem into smaller, independently solvable sub-problems

components.description_pt: Aplicar etapas do ciclo de design iterativo para desenvolver e refinar uma solução para um problema definido
components.description_en: Apply iterative design cycle steps to develop and refine a solution to a defined problem
components.cc_component_description: Apply iterative design cycle steps to develop and refine a solution to a defined problem

components.description_pt: Avaliar um projeto de design concluído contra critérios originais para determinar sucesso ou revisão necessária
components.description_en: Evaluate a completed design project against original criteria to determine success or needed revision
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate a completed design project against original criteria to determine success or needed revision

components.description_pt: Implementar uma solução final progredindo de especificação de alto nível para código concreto
components.description_en: Implement a final solution by progressively moving from high-level specification to concrete code
components.cc_component_description: Construct or implement a designed solution that demonstrably meets specified criteria and constraints

cc_matches.description: Undertake a design project, engaging in the design cycle, to construct and/or implement a solution that meets specific design criteria and constraints.
Design a solution to a complex real-world problem by breaking it down into smaller, more manageable problems that can be solved through engineering.
Define a simple design problem that can be solved through the development of an object, tool, process, or system and includes several criteria for success and constraints on materials, time, or cost.
